rules.label: Sponsorship disclosure near the beginning
rules.source_quote: Please make clear near the beginning of the integration that this video is sponsored by Aegis VPN.

rules.label: Integration length
rules.source_quote: The integration should run no shorter than one minute and no longer than one minute and thirty seconds.

rules.label: Campaign discount
rules.source_quote: viewers should be told that they can save seventy-three percent using the campaign offer

rules.label: Campaign URL spoken
rules.source_quote: and should be directed to aegisvpn.com/alex

rules.label: Feature mention
rules.source_quote: Please mention Shield Mode by name at least once.

rules.label: Prohibited claims
rules.source_quote: Avoid describing Aegis VPN as "completely anonymous" or "unhackable."

rules.label: Closing call to action
rules.source_quote: The closing should include a direct call to action telling viewers to visit the campaign URL.

manual_review.source_quote: The product interface should be visible on screen for at least five seconds during the segment.
manual_review.reason: Visual requirement — not verifiable from audio or duration.
